say:1:1035220001:1.text: I'm worried there won't be enough to go around. After all, there are still a lot of people who haven't moved yet.
say:1:1035220001:1.source_cn: 我都担心不够吃呢，毕竟还有很多人没迁走呢。
say:1:1035220001:1.male: I'm worried there won't be enough to go around. After all, there are still a lot of people who haven't moved yet.
say:1:1035220001:1.female: I'm worried there won't be enough to go around. After all, there are still a lot of people who haven't moved yet.

say:2:1035220002:1.text: That includes a lot of hungry, growing children in need of good nutrition!
say:2:1035220002:1.source_cn: 而且还有不少小孩子，他们正在长身体，得多吃点补充营养才行！
say:2:1035220002:1.male: That includes a lot of hungry, growing children in need of good nutrition!
say:2:1035220002:1.female: That includes a lot of hungry, growing children in need of good nutrition!
